definitions.explanation: An event where companies display and demonstrate their products and services to potential business customers, typically held at a convention center.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}の{見本市|みほんいち}に{出展|しゅってん}する。
examples.english: We will exhibit at next week's trade fair.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{見本市|みほんいち}には{多|おお}くの{企業|きぎょう}が{参加|さんか}する。
examples.english: Many companies participate in the international trade show.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}で{開|ひら}かれた{見本市|みほんいち}で{新商品|しんしょうひん}のデモンストレーションを{行|おこな}い、{多|おお}くの{注文|ちゅうもん}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: We demonstrated our new products at a trade fair held in Tokyo and received many orders.

notes:
Compound of {見本|みほん} (sample) + {市|いち} (market). Literally a "sample market" where goods are displayed for potential buyers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国際|こくさい}{見本市|みほんいち} (international trade fair)
- {見本市|みほんいち}に{出展|しゅってん}する (to exhibit at a trade fair)
- {見本市|みほんいち}{会場|かいじょう} (trade fair venue)

USAGE:
The English loanword {展示会|てんじかい} is also used, though {見本市|みほんいち} emphasizes the commercial, business-to-business nature of the event.
